assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: standalone editorial photograph for a fictitious children's boutique design demo, not a website mockup.
Primary request: Two fully clothed children aged 4–7 candidly walking together in a warm Colombian colonial courtyard, wearing timeless cream and sage outfits.
Scene/backdrop: warm stone courtyard, wood architectural details, soft natural daylight.
Style/medium: realistic editorial lifestyle photography, natural skin and fabric textures, gentle candid expressions.
Composition/framing: landscape 3:2 or wider, full-body children near center-right to permit cropping, breathing room and courtyard on left.
Constraints: no text, no logos, no watermarks, no UI, no graphic layout. Fictitious demo photo.

Asset type: standalone fictitious children's boutique demo apparel photograph.

Style/medium: realistic refined product photography, natural woven fabric detail, softly diffused daylight from left, gentle soft shadow.
Composition/framing: portrait 3:4, centered complete garment with generous consistent margins, straight-on camera, simple warm beige background.
Constraints: only one garment and its hanger, no person, no text, no logo, no watermark, no website or graphic layout.
